goals: Verify that the hourly rate salary range filter dropdowns on the Gumtree job search page contain 11 options.
Verify that the annual salary range filter dropdowns on the Gumtree job search page contain 11 options.
activities: Make an HTTP GET request to the hourly rate jobs URL.
Assert that the HTTP request was successful.
Parse the HTML content of the response.
Find the HTML element for the minimum salary range filter.
Parse the HTML content of the minimum salary range filter element.
Extract all non-empty integer values from the minimum salary options.
Assert that 11 minimum salary options were extracted.
Find the HTML element for the maximum salary range filter.
Parse the HTML content of the maximum salary range filter element.
Extract all non-empty integer values from the maximum salary options.
Assert that 11 maximum salary options were extracted.
